deadline.value: Fall international PhD applications are due March 1; the page prints no year, so 2027 is inferred for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Thesis and PhD Domestic June 1 November 1 International March 1 October 1

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires the GRE for its MS or PhD applications.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required for application of our MS and PhD programs.

gre_subject.value: The department no longer requires the GRE for its PhD applications.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are no longer required for application of our MS and PhD programs.

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed before starting; the chair of graduate affairs advises new doctoral students in their first semester.
supervisor.quote: No. All incoming doctoral and master’s students are advised by CBE’s chair of graduate affairs for their first semester in the program.

funding.value: Students admitted to the PhD are fully supported with an assistantship, stipend and tuition, as long as they make satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Students admitted to the Ph.D. in chemical engineering are fully supported through research and teaching assistantships that include a living stipend and fully paid tuition, fees, and health insurance for as long as they are making satisfactory progress towards their degree

entry_route.value: Many PhD students are admitted straight from a bachelor's degree, but some hold post-bachelor's coursework or a degree.
entry_route.quote: but many are admitted to the program directly from their bachelor’s degree

notes: The department admits PhD students mainly for Fall. Admission is by committee; the advisor is assigned after the first semester.
